info.title: Sparr API Documentation
info.description: API documentation for the interview preparation platform.

post.description: Creates a user and returns a Sanctum personal access token. Use the token in Authorize to call protected endpoints.

token.description: Sanctum personal access token; this is not a JWT.

422.description: Invalid input, an email already in use, or a password confirmation mismatch.

post.description: Returns a new Sanctum personal access token for valid credentials.

token.description: Paste this token into Authorize without the Bearer prefix.

post.description: Revokes only the Bearer token used for this request. Other tokens remain valid. Clear the revoked token from Authorize after logging out.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked Bearer token.

get.description: Returns only the authenticated user's job descriptions, newest created_at first. Description text and skills are omitted. The current list query returns updated_at as null.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Records per page. Defaults to 15; the current endpoint does not enforce an upper limit.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked Bearer token.

post.description: Saves the job description and queues AI skill extraction. The initial state is pending; since the record is refreshed before responding, processing may already have advanced. Poll the detail endpoint until parsing_status is completed or failed. Extraction requires a queue worker and the configured Python service. The creation response omits description and skills.

201.description: Job description created and extraction queued.

message.example: Job Description created successfully and queued for AI skill extraction.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked Bearer token.

422.description: Invalid title, company name, or description.

get.summary: Get a job description and its extracted skills
get.description: Returns a job description owned by the authenticated user, including description and skills. Use this endpoint to poll extraction status. A failed extraction is represented by parsing_status=failed in an HTTP 200 response; no processing_error field is returned.

data.title: Laravel Backend Developer
data.description: We are looking for a backend developer experienced in Laravel, PHP, MySQL, and REST APIs.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked Bearer token.

404.description: The record does not exist or belongs to another user. The response shape differs between these cases.

status.description: Only present for an existing record owned by another user.

get.description: Returns only the authenticated user's resumes, newest ID first, with 15 records per page. Extracted text and skills are not included.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked Bearer token.

post.description: Upload a PDF or TXT file up to 5120 KB (5 MiB). File contents are deduplicated per user; uploading identical contents reuses the existing record without changing its title or restarting processing. New files are processed in the background. Poll GET /api/v1/resumes/{resume} until parsing_status is completed or failed. Processing requires a queue worker and a configured Python service. The upload response omits extracted_text and skills.

202.description: New resume uploaded and queued for processing. reused is false and the initial parsing_status is pending. A queue worker changes it to processing when analysis starts; poll the detail endpoint for updates. message: "Resume uploaded and queued for processing."

200.description: Identical contents already exist for this user. reused is true; data contains the existing resume in its current state. message: "This resume already exists. The existing resume is reused."

example.message: This resume already exists. The existing resume is reused.

201.description: New resume saved, but background processing could not be started. reused is false and parsing_status is failed.

example.message: Resume uploaded, but processing could not be started.

data.title: Backend Developer CV
data.processing_error: Resume processing failed. Please try again later.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked Bearer token.

422.description: Missing or invalid file, file larger than 5120 KB, or invalid title.

get.summary: Get a resume and its extracted skills
get.description: Returns a resume owned by the authenticated user, including extracted_text and skills. Use this endpoint to poll processing status. A failed processing job is represented by parsing_status=failed in a successful HTTP 200 response.

data.title: Backend Developer CV
data.extracted_text: Backend developer experienced in Laravel and MySQL.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked Bearer token.

404.description: Resume does not exist or belongs to another user. Non-numeric IDs do not match the route.

message.description: Example for a missing numeric ID. Wording may vary with route matching and debug settings.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked Bearer token.

description.example: We are looking for a backend developer experienced in Laravel, PHP, MySQL, and REST APIs.

skills.description: Extracted skills. May be empty before processing completes.

description.description: Optional in the API validation. When provided, this text is sent to the Python service for skill extraction.
description.example: We are looking for a backend developer experienced in Laravel, PHP, MySQL, and REST APIs.

parsing_status.description: pending: queued; processing: extraction started; completed: skills are available; failed: extraction ultimately failed.

updated_at.description: Currently null in list responses because the list query does not select this column.

extracted_text.description: May be null before processing completes.
extracted_text.example: Backend developer experienced in Laravel and MySQL.

skills.description: Extracted skills. May be empty before processing completes.

parsing_status.description: pending: queued; processing: analysis has started; completed: results are available; failed: processing could not start or ultimately failed.

processing_error.description: Null unless parsing_status is failed; then returns "Resume processing failed. Please try again later."

file.description: Required PDF or TXT file, maximum 5120 KB. Both its extension and detected content type are checked.

title.description: Optional; must be non-empty when provided. If omitted, uses the filename without its extension, truncated to 45 characters.

message.example: Resume uploaded and queued for processing.

reused.description: True when identical file contents already exist for this user.

email_verified_at.description: May be omitted in the registration response.

errors.description: Field names mapped to lists of validation messages. Messages depend on the submitted data.

bearerAuth.description: Enter the token returned by login or registration, without the Bearer prefix.
